text: Owner decision, 2026-09-08: eyes4s must subsume eyesim basic scientific capabilities more coherently, provide an excellent direct-user experience, and establish a foundation for future modular eye-movement analysis. A future analysis UI is a consumer in a separate repository. The adopted documents are docs/VISION.md, docs/EYESIM_CAPABILITIES.md, and docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. The pinned baseline is task-based, includes an executable route for basic template modeling, and does not import every advanced eyesim export into core. The plan uses six milestones: baseline contract, scientific workflows, direct usability, persistent analyses, downstream extension/application proof, and foundation acceptance. Scientific and usability work proceed together; the first plan persists a concrete baseline workflow. Existing invariants and scientific evidence obligations remain. Evidence is proportional to explicit claims; verified equivalent cases must agree, divergences need independent justification, and numerical tolerances do not weaken exact content identity. The licensed EDF programme and new vendor depth do not block pure core development; real portable ASC support retains a fixture gate. See roadmap bd-01M02N4AVNKKTEV3SA5PR0H4S8 for the detailed dependency reconciliation. This decision replaces the prior draft vision and conflicting product/sequence prose; it does not close scientific implementation work.
